change: Expectations gains a golden element, so a dataset can declare a D2 outcome
defect_closed: Layer.D2_GOLDEN existed in the vocabulary and was mapped in evaluate.PROBE_FOR, but declared_layers() was computed from parity, replay, invariants and faults alone - so it was never returned and never swept. Dead vocabulary since Step 1.
cost_while_open: DS-ACT-INHOUSE exists mainly to supply an in-house reservation for three golden-master surfaces that had none, and that was the one thing about it the registry could not check. It had to be verified by hand.

design.observation: membership in the capture. A surface that resolved is a key in it; one whose resolver found no entity is simply absent - which is why the state is derived from membership rather than a status field.
design.declarable_states: RESOLVED and UNRESOLVED only, refused at registration otherwise.
design.why_UNRESOLVED_matters: it is how a dataset states which populations it deliberately does NOT carry, so quietly acquiring one later is a failure rather than an unnoticed change.

commissioning: 8 checks, 0 failed. The declaration is falsified four ways and each is caught: claiming an UNRESOLVED surface resolves, claiming a RESOLVED one does not, an unknown surface, and the sweep itself - D2_GOLDEN must appear in declared_layers or every expectation would silently be NOT_RUN rather than compared, which was the original defect.
first_use: DS-ACT-INHOUSE declares 7 surfaces - the 3 it was written to resolve, plus 4 it deliberately does not carry. 59 expectations, all met.
